tests.name: Search users (case-insensitive name, e-mail fragment, no match)
tests.expected: uppercase name finds Sipho; e-mail fragment finds exactly Sipho; nonsense returns empty list
tests.actual: name hit=True, e-mail hit=True, no match=True

tests.name: Hide and unhide a user
tests.expected: hidden user disappears from the people list and returns after unhide

tests.name: Delete a message for me only
tests.expected: recipient no longer sees it; sender still does

tests.name: Delete for everyone (sender) and delete a non-existent message
tests.expected: 200 and message gone for both; 404 for unknown id

tests.name: Clear chat for me
tests.expected: caller's history is empty afterwards; the other user's history is unchanged

tests.name: Change preferred language then re-translate a text message
tests.expected: language saved (200); re-translation returns Sesotho text that differs from the isiZulu text and replaces the stored translation
tests.actual: patch=200, translate=200 in 1.37s, lang=sot_Latn, changed=True, stored matches=True

tests.name: Upload a .docx document and translate it
tests.actual: upload=200, translate=200, text='Sicela ulethe umazisi wakho emtholampilo ngoMsombuluko.'

tests.name: Upload a .pdf document (text extracted)
tests.expected: upload 200 and the PDF text is extracted into the message
tests.actual: upload=200, text='Please bring your identity document.'

tests.name: Upload a file larger than 10 MB
Message between two users with the same language
tests.expected: 200; text unchanged; no model call needed (fast)

tests.name: Invalid preferred language and unknown recipient
tests.expected: 400 for an unsupported language; 404 for a recipient that does not exist

tests.name: Protected endpoints require a token
tests.expected: 403 (no bearer token) on every protected route
